_provenance.selection_methodology: Hand-authored must/must_not records built directly on entities and non-entities vendored_seed.json already documents, so no new judgment call about what's sensitive is made in this fixture: `must` entries reuse `persons`/`terms` entries (blindfold targets per ADR-0013); `must_not` entries reuse ADR-0013's own curation notes on what was explicitly excluded from the entity graph (org_units are structure, never blindfolded) plus a near-miss token that shares no L2 surface form with any seeded variation (token-boundary guard, not a curated exception). One record adds a real L1 PII must entry (RFC 2606 .example email, unrelated to any seeded entity so the L1 regex path -- not L2 -- is what's under test) and its own must_not (a bare digit run without the '+' _PHONE_RE requires). One record's must entry is tagged layer L3 (a novel org name, deliberately not seeded anywhere) to exercise the L1/L2-only gating skip -- CI has no local adjudicator, and #260/ADR-0048 hold that even a wired one wouldn't be reproducible yet.
